name: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate

fee.note: Microsoft prices by exam country/region; the exam page shows the price for your location, before taxes.

exam.format: Proctored 100-minute exam through Pearson VUE; interactive components may appear. Microsoft Learn can be opened during the exam, with no extra time. Microsoft does not publish the question count or question types per exam.

scope: Preparing, modeling, visualizing and analyzing data in Power BI, and managing and securing Power BI; Power Query and DAX are expected.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Microsoft says most of its exams have 40–60 questions but does not publish the count for PL-300.

prep.title: Microsoft Learn: Design and manage analytics solutions using Power BI (PL-300T00)
prep.note: Self-paced learning paths are free; the instructor-led delivery is paid.

prep.title: Official PL-300 practice assessment
prep.note: On AI Skills Navigator; needs a sign-in.

domains_note: Weights are the midpoints of the ranges in the Microsoft Learn PL-300 study guide (25–30%, 25–30%, 25–30%, 15–20%; skills measured as of April 20, 2026), rounded to whole numbers that add up to 100. Rounding ties go to the domains listed first. Read 2026-11-17.
